Rig dump for the rifle viewmodel (2026-09-28), built from the M4A1 model in the place
(Workspace.M4A1: seven MeshParts - body, magazine, barrel, grip, handguard, sight, stock -
uploaded under the owner's account). It replaces the earlier Cube 3D carbine, which read
as a smooth plastic blob in first person. Scale 1.3 relative to the source model.
Positions are relative to Main (the receiver). Muzzle faces -Z. The M4 has no separate
charging handle mesh, so there is no Slide bone; the slide spring simply has nothing to
move. Markers were placed from the geometry: Muzzle at the barrel's front face,
CasingEject on the right of the receiver, HandRMount on the pistol grip, HandLMount under
the handguard.

Regenerate assets/viewmodels/rifle.model.json from this with:
    python3 scripts/build_viewmodel.py rifle
